system.description:
Your shadow is a separate entity from yourself, and you can dispatch in your service a few minutes at a time. It cannot speak, but it can gesture. It can also interact with other shadows, and by extension, objects that cast them. It could, for example, pick up a quill by its shadow to write a message. Whenever a task or challenge tests its abilities, make an AGILITY | MAGIC check to control it.

While dispatched, your errant shadow can suffer harm, and the wounds it suffers appear upon you. Combat and other disturbances will send it scampering back to your side.
